name: restoke
description: Restoke hospitality back-of-house analytics via the myHub-hosted MCP gateway. List venue IDs for HQ-level accounts and pull row-level Reports API data (covers, sales, labor, waste, and more) for a date range. Single account-level restaurant/HQ key, no OAuth.

connection.instructions: Nothing to connect — this server authenticates with a single account-level restaurant/HQ API key (a UUID) baked into the myHub-hosted MCP gateway's environment, not a per-user or per-tenant credential. To (re)provision the key, generate it in Restoke and provide it to mySMB ops to register as the RESTOKE_CLIENT_SECRET_STAGING / production secret on myhub-mcp-servers.
